meta.name: Phật Hào · Quản lý hồ sơ
meta.description: Rebuild screen hierarchy around records, review queues and optional statistics. Reference is a neutral issue-management workspace. Exact colors measured; spacing and interactions inferred from a still image.

color.palette_type: Neutral gray surfaces with sparse semantic status accents

primary.role: Measured foreground; headings and readable table content

secondary.role: Measured blue; focus and chart strokes

accent.role: Measured amber; pending review counts that need staff attention

neutral.usage: Ordered light to dark. Background #f0f0f0 and dark endpoint #151515 measured. #f7f7f7 popup/control surface and #c8c8ca borders are derived neutral steps. Small copy uses measured #60645d.

color.contrast_strategy: High contrast copy on gray; amber background always paired with dark label and numeric count; status never conveyed solely by hue.

brand_exceptions.status_colors: Retain existing green approval and red rejection meaning; no decorative colored card backgrounds
brand_exceptions.controls: Near-white controls and dialogs distinguish editable fields from flat gray canvas

accessibility_adjustments.usage: Dark readable label over the measured amber pending badge
Darker blue for small text; measured original reserved for chart marks

typography.font_style_notes: Rounded geometric sans inferred from reference; keep existing self-hosted Geist with Vietnamese glyphs rather than claiming an exact font identification.

spacing.section_rhythm: 8–16px within toolbars; 20–24px content gutter; 44–52px data rows

layout.grid_system: Full viewport continuous gray topbar and sidebar; flat main surface with compact filters, counts, mode navigation and list. Statistics and pending are separate working views.

elevation.shadow_style: Flat page and tables; shadows only on floating menus, tooltip and modal
elevation.depth_cues: Neutral surface changes and fine row dividers; elevated controls only

iconography.style: Monochrome outlined utility icons; no ornamental icon disks

motion.entrance_pattern: instant, no entrance animation inferred from still image

components.button_style: Small gray utility buttons; dark primary for committing a form; semantic green/red for review
components.input_style: Near-white rectangular fields, subtle border and visible blue focus; compact filter controls
components.card_style: Avoid cards around lists. Plain divided rows and one working surface. Bounded boxes only for dialog, form and optional statistics.
components.navigation_pattern: Gray full-height rail with light selected row. List / Pending / Statistics mode buttons with underline. Logo remains in continuous topbar.
components.modal_style: Centered opaque white dialog with thin border; no backdrop blur
components.list_style: Primary working view; compact rows, aligned columns, searchable and sortable data, existing export, pagination and detailed sheet controls.
components.component_notes: Remove promotional hero, multicolor background, stat cards and always-visible chart grid. Put records first; show pending counts in amber. Preserve roles and backend contracts.

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Only functional separation; no oversized hero or outer frame
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Names and pending states are strongest, supporting metadata is gray
visual_language.focal_strategy: Immediate access to records and pending review; analytics on demand
visual_language.contrast_level: dark-on-light dominant, low contrast structural borders

composition.hierarchy_method: Task-based modes, aligned rows and sparse semantic status accents
composition.balance_type: asymmetric sidebar plus aligned main grid
composition.grouping_strategy: One work surface with separators; filters in a dismissible popup
composition.negative_space_role: Distinguish controls from records without wasting vertical space

imagery.photo_treatment: Existing portraits kept; no decorative stock photography
imagery.graphic_elements: Utility icons, actual portraits and optional data charts only

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate selected state and clear loading/empty/error states
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Subtle gray row highlight; delayed utility tooltip and keyboard focus
interaction_feel.loading_style: Static placeholders and spinner only during a request
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: Only to explain actions or state; no bounce, reveal or ornamental animation

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: calm and helpful Vietnamese appropriate to Đạo Tràng
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: explain available next steps without fabricated data

overview.fallback_strategy: No decorative effects; reduced motion disables transitions and spinner
overview.primary_technology: CSS with native HTML controls and static SVG chart

background_effects.description: Flat measured gray; no gradient frame

canvas_drawings.description: Use responsive static SVG area chart; existing image crop canvas remains functional, not a visual effect

svg_animations.description: SVG chart and icons are static; tooltip follows pointer/focus without SVG animation

visual_effects.composite_notes: Still reference provides no timing evidence. Inferred interactions: 120ms color transitions, 450ms tooltip dwell, immediate focus feedback. No WebGL, blur, animations, scene effects or decorative cards. Retain actual data chart and avatar crop behavior.
